title: PluginDisabledPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'plugin.disabled'. Loombre Plugin Protocol (LPP) v1, Lane W2 (LD4/LD6/LD8): emitted in the SAME transaction whenever plugins.enabled flips false (packages/db/src/query/plugins.ts's setPluginEnabledAndEmit) — an explicit admin action (reason='admin'), the circuit breaker crossing packages/plugin-host's LPP_BREAKER_FAILURE_THRESHOLD consecutive call failures (reason='breaker', envelope.actorUserId is null — system-originated), or an expanding re-fetch diff (reason='scope-change', see docs on apps/server/src/plugins/plugin-registration.service.ts for the exact expansion definition). ADMIN-ONLY delivery, mirroring settings.updated exactly.

pluginId.description: The plugins.id row that was disabled.

disabledAtMs.description: Epoch ms this row was updated to enabled=false.
